headline: resk-llm-ts secures TypeScript LLM pipelines with 11 threat detectors in one npm package
summary: This open-source TypeScript library inspects every LLM input with 11 independent detectors, blocking prompt injections, jailbreaks, and PII leaks before they reach your model. It offers structural security where 70% of organizations lack AI governance.
details: resk-llm-ts is an open-source TypeScript library designed to secure LLM endpoints by inspecting every user request. It features 11 independent threat detectors to block malicious content before it reaches your model, addressing common attack vectors like prompt injections, jailbreak attempts, and PII leaks.

The library sits between your API route and your LLM call, providing a crucial security layer. Each of the 11 detectors is an independent module that can be individually enabled or disabled, offering flexible configuration for different security needs.

According to PwC, 70% of organizations lack proper AI governance, often relying solely on brittle prompt engineering for defense. resk-llm-ts provides structural security at the gateway, preventing malicious tokens from ever reaching your LLM provider.
Built and maintained by RESK Security, the library is available via npm and is licensed under GPL-3.0. It requires Node.js 18+ and TypeScript 5.x, with no other external dependencies.
caption:
70% of organizations lack AI governance. Secure your TypeScript LLM endpoints with resk-llm-ts, an npm package featuring 11 threat detectors.

resk-llm-ts is an open-source TypeScript library designed to secure LLM endpoints by inspecting every user request. It features 11 independent threat detectors to block malicious content before it reaches your model, addressing common attack vectors like prompt injections, jailbreak attempts, and PII leaks.

The library sits between your API route and your LLM call, providing a crucial security layer. Each of the 11 detectors is an independent module that can be individually enabled or disabled, offering flexible configuration for different security needs.

According to PwC, 70% of organizations lack proper AI governance, often relying solely on brittle prompt engineering for defense. resk-llm-ts provides structural security at the gateway, preventing malicious tokens from ever reaching your LLM provider.

Built and maintained by RESK Security, the library is available via npm and is licensed under GPL-3.0. It requires Node.js 18+ and TypeScript 5.x, with no other external dependencies.
